## Summary

Explain what this contribution changes and why.

## Contribution type

- [ ] Editorial correction
- [ ] Specification change
- [ ] New RFC
- [ ] Conformance or reference implementation
- [ ] Governance or community process

## Impact

Describe affected communities, implementations and compatibility considerations.

## Trust, privacy and security

Identify relevant consent, credential, data, governance and threat considerations. Write Not applicable only with a short explanation.

## Validation

List review, examples, tests, implementation evidence or conformance checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] I linked the relevant Discussion or Issue.
- [ ] I disclosed material conflicts of interest.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, personal records or confidential information.
- [ ] I followed the Code of Conduct and contribution guidelines.
